title: Glossa usages v1: one build's message usages (RFC 0004 §2.2)
description: Written by @klarlabs-studio/glossa/unplugin (.glossa/usages.json) and by `glossa extract`, uploaded by the CLI. One document is one build: one application at one commit. Usages are sorted by key, file, line, column (strings by Unicode code point); (file, line, column) is unique. Fixtures: runtimes/testdata/usages/.

application.description: The application's slug in the project (catalog Slug rules).

commit.description: Full commit ID, lowercase hex: SHA-1 (40) or SHA-256 (64) repositories.

branch.description: Short branch name (feat/checkout-copy, not refs/heads/…): ref-name components without '..', control characters, spaces, ~^:?*[\{, and no component starting or ending with '.'.

tool.description: What produced the document. Informational: never part of the comparison between extractors.

key.description: The message key as written at the call site (catalog key rules). Resolved to a message ID at ingest; an unknown key is stored, not rejected.

file.description: Path relative to the project root: POSIX separators, no '.' or '..' segments, no empty segment, no leading or trailing slash, no ':' or backslash.

column.description: 1-based column, counted in Unicode code points (not bytes, not UTF-16 units), of the first character of the key inside its quotes, or of the accessor's first path segment.

component.description: Vue/Astro: the file name without extension. JSX/TSX: the nearest enclosing capitalized function or class. Go: pkg.Func, pkg.Type.Method or pkg.(*Type).Method. Absent where none applies.

route.description: Route pattern (not a URL): /checkout/payment, /blog/[slug]. Absent when unknown.

kind.description: t: t()/$t() calls and Go T calls. component: <GlossaText id> (Vue) and <T id> (React). element: <glossa-text|rich|plural|select key|message>. accessor: typed accessors from `glossa generate`. template: {{t}}, {{td}}, {{th}} in Go templates.
